source: ESPN public injury report and game summaries

injuries.name: Evan Mobley
injuries.short_comment: Mobley will receive treatment and participate in rehab after the team confirmed a diagnosis of a right great toe sprain, and he'll be re-evaluated in the next 7-to-10 days.
injuries.long_comment: Mobley is set to miss his third straight game Monday since suffering the injury, and he's slated to miss at least the next week while on the mend. The Cavs should have a better idea on when he'll return to the court as he begins to progress through the treatment and rehab phase.

injuries.name: Nae'Qwan Tomlin
injuries.short_comment: Tomlin (back) will remain on the inactive list for Wednesday's game against the Grizzlies.
injuries.long_comment: Tomlin, who is recovering from a lower back stress reaction, has yet to suit up for the Cavs this season. He continues to get ruled out 24 hours in advance of tipoff, indicating he's still not close, so he can be viewed as week-to-week moving forward.

injuries.name: Jordan Clarkson
injuries.short_comment: Clarkson (foot) is out for Wednesday's game against Cleveland.
injuries.long_comment: The veteran guard is missing a fourth consecutive contest with plantar fasciitis in his right foot. Clarkson didn't practice Tuesday and lacks a timeline for his return.

injuries.name: Josh Hart
injuries.short_comment: Hart (shoulder) is listed as questionable for Wednesday's game against Cleveland.
injuries.long_comment: Hart is dealing with a right shoulder sprain after dropping a triple-double in Sunday's win over Indiana. If the veteran wing joins OG Anunoby (calf) on the inactive list Wednesday, Mohamed Diawara and Pacome Dadiet would be candidates for an uptick in minutes.

injuries.name: Karl-Anthony Towns
injuries.short_comment: Towns (knee) is questionable for Wednesday's game against Cleveland.
injuries.long_comment: Towns is at risk of sitting out for the second time in New York's last three contests. Andre Drummond would be a plug-and-play fantasy option at center in most settings if Towns is ultimately unable to play Wednesday.

injuries.name: OG Anunoby
injuries.short_comment: Anunoby (calf) is out for Wednesday's game against Cleveland.
injuries.long_comment: Wednesday marks a third consecutive absence for Anunoby, who was unable to practice Tuesday because of a sore left calf. His continued void in the lineup should keep Landry Shamet in the streaming conversation in most fantasy leagues Wednesday.

injuries.name: Miles McBride
injuries.short_comment: McBride (adductor) is listed as questionable for Wednesday's game versus Cleveland.
injuries.long_comment: McBride could miss a second straight game due to left adductor tightness, though he was able to participate in Tuesday's practice. If the 26-year-old guard remains sidelined, Tyler Kolek, Jose Alvarado and Pacome Dadiet would be candidates for increased playing time.
